content: MK reports that Qāżīzāda Rūmī, in a letter of thanks of about 829/1426 on receiving a copy of Ibn Turka's lettrist Sharḥ al-Basmala, eulogized his mastery of the whole Islamic tradition and his spiritual perfection as an occultist, calling him "the alchemical matrix of everlasting life and eternal collyrium".
